_comment: Provenance of the pinned Neutrino bindings. scripts/release-manifest.py check-provenance refuses a build where this file, gradle/libs.versions.toml (neutrino =) and the neutrinoSha256 in build.gradle.kts disagree, or where the downloaded .aar hashes differently. Bump all three together; the revs must be full 40-character commit SHAs whose 7-character prefixes appear in the version string.
